body:
Doc prescribed skelaxin for a pulled back. Honestly didn't notice any effect. Positive or negative. Helped a little bit I guess with the flexibility.
One side effect for me was acne. Serious, cyst-like acne. Would happen after about 4 straight days of taking it. Boils...large red zits on my forehead, chin, cheeks, like I was 15 again.  Once I stopped for 3 days the acne would go away.
Another huge side effect was sweating. My god the sweating. Be sitting in an AC cooled living room and sweat would bead up and be rolling down my torso and back. Once again, this stopped once I quit taking the pills.
IMO not  worth the side effects. Best relief was tramadol :). Peace
